prompt: Editorial music-release cover, 16:9. A field-grade atmospheric backdrop with heavy film grain: deep moss green and ink black mass on the right fading into burnt orange and rust on the left, with a teal-blue smudge in the upper right quadrant. The grain is intentional and uniform across the whole frame, like a high-ISO 35mm print. Centered in the frame, occupying about 40 percent of the width, sits a flat cream card (#F2E8D6) with no shadow, no border, no gradient. On the card, three stacked lines of solid black uppercase geometric sans type (Archivo / Futura class), centered: the largest reads 'SOMETHING IN THE WAY', the medium reads 'TRIPLE J / LIKE A VERSION', the smallest reads 'A RUBBER DUCK COVER'. Mood: editorial, hushed, music-release, grain-on-paper. No people, no objects other than the card. The whole image should feel like a single-panel album sleeve rather than a product shot.
